description: This file defines the ListViewController class within the Api\V8\Controller namespace. It manages list view operations, specifically handling requests to retrieve list view column definitions via dependency injection of a ListViewService. The class extends a BaseController and provides a getListViewColumns method which interacts with the service and handles exceptions.

classes.name: Api\V8\Controller\ListViewController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling list view related API requests, specifically retrieving column definitions for list views.

methods.description: Processes incoming request to retrieve list view column definitions, returns JSON response, or error response if an exception occurs.
